probability_interpretation.early_warning_1yr: Cumulative probability that a first low season belonging to a subsequently confirmed decline begins within 1 year(s).
probability_interpretation.early_warning_2yr: Cumulative probability that a first low season belonging to a subsequently confirmed decline begins within 2 year(s).
probability_interpretation.early_warning_3yr: Cumulative probability that a first low season belonging to a subsequently confirmed decline begins within 3 year(s).
probability_interpretation.early_warning_4yr: Cumulative probability that a first low season belonging to a subsequently confirmed decline begins within 4 year(s).
probability_interpretation.early_warning_5yr: Cumulative probability that a first low season belonging to a subsequently confirmed decline begins within 5 year(s).
probability_interpretation.early_warning_risk_in_year_h: Monotone cumulative-risk difference between horizons h and h-1; this is an incremental risk mass, not a conditional hazard.
probability_interpretation.next_season_confirmation: Conditional probability that a player already in a first low season remains below 65% of the prior adjusted-minutes peak in the next adjacent season.

followup_rule: Early-warning horizons are 1-5 years. Deployment training requires season_start + horizon + 1 <= data_end_season; the extra year confirms a possible onset at the fifth-year boundary.
